definitions.explanation: A person employed by a company, typically as a regular full-time employee.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{大|おお}きな{会社|かいしゃ}の{社員|しゃいん}だ。
examples.english: She is an employee of a large company.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}の{研修|けんしゅう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Training for new employees has begun.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}で{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I eat lunch at the employee cafeteria.

notes:
{社員|しゃいん} combines {社|しゃ} (company) + {員|いん} (member).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん} (new employee)
- {正|せい}{社員|しゃいん} (regular/full-time employee)
- {社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう} (employee cafeteria)
- {社員|しゃいん}{旅行|りょこう} (company trip)
- {社員|しゃいん}{割引|わりびき} (employee discount)

SIMILAR TERMS:
- {社員|しゃいん}: company employee (general)
- {会社員|かいしゃいん}: office worker, company employee
- {従業員|じゅうぎょういん}: employee (more formal/general)
- スタッフ: staff (from English)

USAGE NOTES:
- {社員|しゃいん} implies full-time regular employment
- Part-time workers are usually not called {社員|しゃいん}
